Prototype 5 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (96%), with EOG (2%) and EMG (2%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+9.8 dB, sensitivity=18.2) and elevated β_h (+0.3 dB, sensitivity=17.5).
The δ activity is present in 86% of each epoch (sustained), with moderate eye movements (SEM 66% active (likely EEG crosstalk)) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is conflicting with N2 physiology: missing: σ relevant, EOG quiescent.
